name: Clicks Advance Forms Builder | Drag and Drop WordPress Form Builder
author: sykologicist

sections.description:
Clicks Advance Forms Builder is the most intuitive, feature-rich, and developer-friendly drag-and-drop WordPress forms plugin. Designed to help you build everything from a simple contact form to complex multi-step forms, school admission requests, job applications, and online order checkouts in minutes without writing a single line of code.

Whether you need a free form builder to collect subscriber emails or a premium form builder to capture leads, process payments, and automate user registration, Clicks Advance Forms Builder delivers a high-speed, mobile-responsive experience out-of-the-box.

Why Choose Clicks Advance Forms Builder?

  • Intuitive Drag & Drop Builder: Build beautiful forms directly inside a modern canvas editor with instant live preview.
  • 100% Mobile Responsive Layouts: Every form you design fits seamlessly on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices automatically.
  • Paginated Multi-Step Forms: Increase form conversions by breaking long forms into step-by-step pages with beautiful progress bars and indicators.
  • 28+ Pre-made Form Templates (Free): Launch instantly with basic layouts including Contact Us, Newsletter Sign-up, RSVP, Bug Report, lead capture, and appointment bookings.
  • 23+ Advanced Form Templates (Pro): Unlock complex configurations like Job Applications with file uploads, Patient Intake, Real Estate Listings, Course Reviews, and IT incident tickets.
  • Gutenberg & Shortcode Integrations: Embed your forms anywhere inside posts, pages, or widgets using our native Gutenberg Block or simple shortcode generator.

Key Free Features:

  • Drag & Drop Form Editor.
  • Multi-Step Forms with Page Indicators.
  • Email Notifications on Form Submissions.
  • Custom Redirects or Success Confirmation Messages.
  • Input Field Types: Text, Email, Phone, Number, Dropdown Select, Checkbox, Radio, Date, File Upload, URL, Hidden fields, Section Dividers, and HTML blocks.
  • Star Rating (Lite): Add beautiful 5-star ratings to your feedback forms for free.
  • Range Slider (Lite): Add clean numeric range selectors (0-100) to your pages for free.
  • Template Library Modal to start with blank canvas or 28+ pre-made basic layouts.
  • Comprehensive Stored XSS sanitization and output escaping.

Key Pro Features (Unlock Premium Power):

  • Premium Fields: Signature Pad, Phone + Country Selector, Address Auto-complete (Google Maps API), Repeater Fields, NPS Ratings, Image Choice grid, and Password Strength meters.
  • Geolocation Address Autofill: Automatically detect user location and auto-populate address inputs.
  • PDF Submission Generation: Automatically compile entry data into PDF documents and attach to email alerts.
  • Stripe Recurring Subscriptions: Collect recurring subscription payments directly on your website.
  • Webhooks Integration: Send JSON submission payloads to third-party services like Zapier or Make.
  • Dynamic URL Pre-population: Prefill form inputs automatically using URL query variables.
  • Conditional Email Routing: Route email notifications to different departments dynamically based on form inputs.
  • Custom CSS Editor: Customize forms visually by writing your own CSS directly.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track views, submissions, and conversion rates, along with page drop-off analytics.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clicks-advance-forms-builder directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Click on the “Advance Forms” menu in the sidebar to create your first form.
  4. Place the shortcode [clicks_form id="YOUR_FORM_ID"] on any page, post, or widget.
sections.faq:
How do I embed a form?

Use the shortcode [clicks_form id="X"] where X is the ID of your form, which you can find on the Forms Dashboard.

What file types are allowed for upload?

By default, the plugin supports JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, and ZIP.

2.0.0

  • Major layout overflow CSS fixes to ensure full-screen builder UI scrolls correctly.
  • Added 30 new templates to the Template Library (now offering 51 templates total).
  • Relocated Rating Stars and Range Slider to Free Lite fields.
  • Added Stripe Subscriptions payments integration (Pro).
  • Added automated PDF generation attachments on form submissions (Pro).
  • Added Geolocation Address Autofill (Pro).
  • Added Dynamic URL Parameter pre-population (Pro).
  • Added Conditional Email Routing (Pro).
  • Added Custom CSS Styling editor (Pro).
  • Added security enhancements and stored XSS sanitization checks.

1.0.0

  • Initial production release.
